label: Agent workflow branch_in execution test
description: branch_in-only slice of a generated agent workflow (chat + telegram channels), used by AgentWorkflowExecutionIntTest to execute the real branch_in dispatcher through a JobSyncExecutor-based harness. The branch_in task below is byte-for-byte what AgentWorkflowGenerator.generate(...) emits as tasks[0] for the two-channel (chat, telegram) fixture agent that AgentWorkflowExecutionIntTest builds -- pinned by testGeneratedBranchInMatchesExecutionFixture so this file can never silently drift from the generator. aiAgent_1 and branch_out are intentionally omitted: this test only exercises branch_in's inbound envelope mapping, not the LLM call or the outbound reply.
